Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'звать'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to call, to name', paired with 'называть'.

examples.trans: You called me a bad word.

examples.text: Ты назвал меня плохим словом. Меня, начальника!
examples.trans: You called me a bad word. Me, your boss!

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'кормить'). Used in Russian as a perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to feed'.

examples.trans: The cook fed the guests deliciously.

examples.text: Раз не можем напоить, мы его накормим!
examples.trans: Since we cannot give him drink, we will feed him!

examples.text: Мы накормим его вкусным горячим обедом.
examples.trans: We will feed him a delicious hot lunch.

meanings.note: Governs на + accusative. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hint, imply'.

examples.text: На кого ты сейчас намекаешь, майор?

examples.text: А я ни на кого не намекаю.
examples.trans: And I am not hinting at anyone.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'писать'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to write', paired with 'писать'.

examples.text: А зачем? Я сам сделал так, чтобы он его написал.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to manage without, do without; to turn out', paired with 'обходиться'.
